jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
The Company

CommerceIQ is building the AI platform that runs commerce for the world's largest brands. We are not selling AI demos. We are shipping AI agents for content, media, and sales into the workflows of the Fortune 100 every week.

Customers include Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre-IPO.

Role summary

Own finance, accounting, and statutory compliance for CommerceIQ's India entity, serving as the primary point of contact for banking relationships, tax authorities, and statutory auditors. Partner with the global controllership team in the US to keep India operations aligned with company-wide policy and reporting standards, manage and develop a small India finance team, and act as an authorized signatory across banking, tax, and regulatory portals.

Key responsibilities

1. Accounting, Reporting & Statutory Compliance

- Own day-to-day accounting, reconciliations, and the monthly/quarterly/annual close in NetSuite; prepare financial dashboards for leadership.

- Serve as the company's primary owner for Indian statutory compliance (GST, TDS/withholding tax, corporate income tax, PF/PT, STPI), including ownership of GST and TDS reporting and configuration within NetSuite (e-Way Bill, GSTIN localization).

- Own EEFC/e-BRC regularization for inward remittances; track evolving labor law requirements and ensure payroll, F&F settlements, and reimbursements stay compliant.

- Maintain Board, AGM, and Company Secretary records in support of annual statutory filings.

2. Banking, Treasury & Payroll

- Act as an authorized initiator on corporate banking platforms (e.g., HSBC) for payments, payroll, fixed deposits, forex/travel advances, and intercompany funding; manage banking relationships directly.

- Administer corporate card programs and coordinate cross-border wire transfers with the US finance team.

- Own monthly payroll approval/processing and oversee F&F settlements for exiting employees.

3. Systems, Audit & Vendor Management

- Maintain and improve processes across supporting finance systems (Tipalti, Navan, FloQast); review NetSuite platform releases with IT for compliance impact.

- Support internal, external, statutory, and GST audits; serve as primary contact for auditors, tax consultants, and the company secretary.

- Manage outsourced accounting, payroll, and tax consultant relationships, including fee negotiation, vendor contracts, and invoice/PO approvals.

4. Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Manage, mentor, and develop the India finance team (AP, AR, and payroll support); act as a trusted advisor to the CFO on India-specific finance and compliance matters.

- Oversee the global AP/AR cycle — invoicing, credit memos, collections escalation — and employee T&E/expense reimbursements.

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance; Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent strongly preferred given the scope of statutory and tax ownership

- 10-12+ years of progressive accounting/finance experience, including prior experience managing a team

- Strong knowledge of Indian GAAP, Ind AS, the Companies Act 2013, and GST/TDS/PF/PT/STPI requirements

- Proven ownership of GST/TDS compliance reporting and configuration within an ERP system, including e-Way Bill and GSTIN localization

- Experience as an authorized signatory/initiator for corporate banking relationships (payments, FDs, forex, EEFC/e-BRC)

- Experience coordinating audits and annual filings with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and company secretaries

- Experience in a global, multi-entity organization partnering with a US-based finance/controllership team across time zones

- Strong vendor negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills; a hands-on "do whatever it takes" attitude

- Good to have: working knowledge of NetSuite, Tipalti, Navan, FloQast, or GreytHR; prior finance experience in a SaaS or ecommerce company

jobs.description:

The Role:

Fueled by our customer and business growth, we’re looking for Customer Success Associate Director, E-commerce to run and grow relationships with our customers, ensuring they are successfully adopting the product.

Working as part of the customer success team, you will play a critical role in onboarding, supporting, and leading strategic direction for our clients. The goal of our Customer Success Managers at CommerceIQ is, simply, to help our customers achieve profitable revenue growth using our platform. They do so by partnering with the CommerceIQ Customer Success Team and other cross-functional partners to onboard, train, and provide day-to-day support for our customers. Customer success is at the heart of what we do so you should have CPG experience working in sales, analytics, or marketing as well as in ecommerce. This is an exciting time to join our fast-growing team.

This position is remote with 15-25% travel expected to client locations.

What You'll Do:

- Act as the connector between retail media strategy and content execution, ensuring that media investments and on-site content are aligned to drive conversion and share growth.

- Work with our customers to understand their ecommerce needs, focusing on how we use our products and services to help them meet those needs

- Provide data-driven content recommendations and optimizations across retailer platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, Target, Chewy, etc.) to maximize visibility and performance.

- Understand Ecommerce data and how it can be used to grow improve profitable market share

- Be an expert on the CommerceIQ platform, helping customers apply best practice strategies to achieve their business goals

- Focus on moving the needle with respect to our customer’s KPIs and continuously showcase the value of CommerceIQs platform throughout the engagement period

- Assist customers with onboarding, training, and deployment of best practices to help customers grow their ecommerce business

- Take ownership of customer service requests through coordinating with the technical support and engineer teams to ensure requests are addressed quickly and with a high level of satisfaction

- Assist our Customer Success Leadership and Professional Services teams in crafting, presenting, and executing Joint Success Plans that focus on driving the most value possible using the CommerceIQ platform and services

- Be the voice of your customers, collaborating with our internal teams to shape new features and help us rapidly develop a product 10x better than the competition

What You'll Bring:

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communication, Economics or related field

- 5+ total years of professional work experience

- 3+ years experience working in the ecommerce industry at a brand, consulting firm, agency, Amazon or related organisation or in relevant category management or analytics roles in the CPG industry

- Strong written and verbal communication, project management and client management skills

- An analytical approach to problem-solving with advanced Excel (and/or *SQL) skills, along with project management experience and ability to anticipate and mitigate risks

- Track record of retaining and renewing Enterprise customers in the SaaS space

- Experience working with all levels of the business, including senior executives

- Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients

Compensation and Benefits:

The typical base pay range for this role across the US is USD: $133,600- $158,000/per year.

This base pay range may be inclusive of several career levels at CommerceIQ and will be narrowed based on a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at CommerceIQ. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock options, as well as potential discretionary bonuses. You will also receive access to:

- Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage

- A 401(k)-retirement plan

- Short & long-term disability insurance

- Life insurance

- Paid parental leave

- Monthly reimbursements for gym, phone, and internet

- 10+ paid company holidays in each calendar year and unlimited PTO

Check out our LinkedIn page to learn more about what it’s like to work at CommerceIQ!
